```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
library(RcmdrShiny)
```

This vignette describes the Wave 6 help centre: the full-text index, filters,
runnable examples, contextual error links, the glossary, the first-run tour and
the live language switch. All of it is offline and local.

## The index

The help centre builds an in-memory index from the registered topics. The index
is a cache, not a second source of truth: it is rebuilt when the registry
revision or the language changes.

```{r index}
help_unregister()
index <- RcmdrShiny:::help_index_build()
names(index)
nrow(index$docs)
```

Titles weigh 5, keywords and aliases 4, headings 3 and the body 1. An exact
title match is boosted so that searching for a topic title puts it first.

```{r ranking}
help_search("numerical summaries")[, c("id", "title", "score")]
help_search("logistic regression", limit = 3)[, c("id", "score")]
```

The index can be filtered by source, category and type:

```{r filters}
nrow(help_search("model", category = "models"))
nrow(help_search("data", type = "tutorial"))
RcmdrShiny:::help_filter_choices()$packages
```

## Examples

Examples are declared in the front matter. Only examples marked `runnable: true`
can be executed, and only after confirmation. The command goes through
`run_command()`, so it is logged in the history exactly like a dialog command.

```{r examples}
topic <- help_topic("numerical-summaries")
examples <- RcmdrShiny:::help_topic_examples(topic)
vapply(examples, function(example) example$runnable, logical(1))
examples[[1L]]$code
```

The help centre replaces `{dataset}` and a conventional `Dataset` name with the
selected data set when the object does not already exist. If no data set is
available, it asks for one instead of running a broken command.

```{r prepare, eval=FALSE}
state <- AppState()
active_dataset(state, "mtcars")
RcmdrShiny:::help_example_prepare_code(state, "summary(Dataset)")
```

## Errors

When a command fails, the error card offers the most likely topic:

```{r errors}
error_help_topic("object 'Dataset' not found")
error_help_topic("there is no package called 'car'")
error_help_topic("contrasts can be applied only to factors with 2 or more levels")
```

Patterns are conservative. An unknown error yields no link rather than a
misleading one.

## Glossary, tour and checklist

The `glossary` topic defines the statistical and interface terms and is part of
the search index. The first-run tour has four steps (data, charts, report,
palette); it is dismissible, can be hidden in the browser's local storage, and
is restartable from **Help > Guided tour**.

```{r tour}
steps <- tour_steps()
vapply(steps, function(step) step$id, character(1))
```

The Home tab derives a checklist from the session: import, summary, chart,
report and the future project step. Project persistence is listed as
unavailable until the platform release enables it.

## Language

The package reads the inherited gettext catalogues and a small TSV overlay for
the Studio's own strings. `tr()` consults the active language first, so the
interface does not need a restart:

```{r language, eval=FALSE}
i18n_set_language("it")
tr("Home")          # "Casa"
tr("Run a summary") # "Esegui un riassunto"
i18n_set_language("en")
```

The choice is saved in the preferences file together with the theme. Menus,
tabs, help topics and server messages re-render immediately; static shell text
is updated on the next page load.

```{r audit, eval=FALSE}
# From the package root
# Rscript tools/audit_i18n.R --language it
```
